name: AIOS Phase 1 Production Baseline Requirement Contract
objective: Complete AIOS Phase 1 with executable evidence for all applicable Definition of Done criteria.
task_specification: Execute RP001 from AT001 using deterministic local inputs, validate P0 controls, and produce a traceable release candidate package.
required_outcomes: Runtime, artifact, QA, promotion, UAT, registry, release and handoff evidence exist
assumptions: A deterministic simulation is acceptable where an external integration is unavailable
constraints: No production status without executable evidence

acceptance_criteria.expected: UAT-001 through UAT-010 pass or simulated pass
